steps.caption: Open More in the sidebar, then Imports.
Earlier uploads are listed with their status and row counts. The original file is kept read-only.
Choose your spreadsheet — here a small CSV with three buildings.
As-of date: when the data in the file was true. Source: where it came from.
The result in three steps: added, needs your OK, could not be imported.
These column names weren't recognised, so the rows wait here — nothing is lost.
Open Technical details to map the columns once.
What is this sheet? An asset list with a header row.
Match each field to a column: Building name ← Property, Locality ← Micro-market…
Press Approve mapping and re-process. Next time this layout imports by itself.
Done: step 1 shows the buildings and localities now in your records (new, or matched to ones you had).
Needs your OK: anything that would change an existing record waits for approval.
Rows with a problem list the reason; 'NA' and '0' areas are kept as unknown, never as numbers.
Possible duplicates: merge look-alike names or keep them separate.
Values that differ from your records are never overwritten — they go to Approvals.
